questions.q: You log in and see sample records about Google, Pets and Rockets. What has happened?
o: You are in a stray demo workspace; switch to IOResource from the workspace menu at the top-left
Somebody imported test data into our workspace
Your account has no permissions yet
questions.e: A stray Twenty demo workspace has appeared on first login before. Our workspace has Companies, People, Opportunities, End Customers and Cases in the sidebar.

questions.q: Which sidebar entry holds the businesses the equipment is ultimately for?
questions.e: Companies are who we sell to. End Customers are who the kit is for, so competing resellers' deals can roll up under one of them.

questions.q: What is the quickest way to make the CRM usable day to day?
o: Star the views you use and work from favourites at the top of the sidebar
Export everything to Excel each morning
Keep the full Companies list open all day
questions.e: Views answer one question each. Starring them turns the sidebar into your daily to-do list.

questions.q: Which of these belongs in the CRM rather than in Intact?
o: The invoice value of last month's order
The stock level of a POS terminal
Who the economic buyer is at the account
The real margin on a shipped order
questions.e: Relationship facts live in the CRM. Money and document facts live in Intact.
